title: BSC Lab — Sensory Stimulation Ontology (SSTIM) and open stimulation platform
description: BSC Lab is an open-source sensory stimulation platform with two integrated layers: a precision multi-engine audiovisual stimulation application, and a knowledge layer built on the SSTIM ontology (OWL class hierarchy, multilingual SKOS vocabulary, SHACL validation shapes, qualified evidence governance, exposure and ecosystem term modules, and external alignments) published at https://w3id.org/sstim under CC BY 4.0. Ecosystem fixtures in the release are synthetic; real live-only agent records must remain outside this archive. Each tagged release is archived here for citation.
